steps.summary: Multi-lane asphalt road with white dashed center line markings and solid white edge lines
Road markings appear to follow North American style with double yellow lines on left side and white edge lines
White rectangular delineator post on right shoulder of road
Dense deciduous forest on both sides of the road with mature hardwood trees
Green grass verge along both roadsides
Partly cloudy sky with blue sky and white cumulus clouds
Flat to gently rolling terrain typical of Midwestern or Eastern United States
Metal guardrail on left side of road
Blue vehicle hood visible in bottom of frame indicating this photo is taken from inside a vehicle

The white and black striped delineator post (e3) is a distinctive German/Central European roadside marker style, not North American as the initial observation suggested. The road merge/lane-narrowing chevron markings on the left, the black/white striped guide posts, and the tree-lined 'Allee' style road with dense deciduous forest are typical of German rural highways (Bundesstraße/Landstraße). The wet road surface and diffuse lighting also fit a temperate European climate. This overrides the earlier note about North American style markings, since the double-yellow-line description doesn't actually match what's visible in the image (only white lines and hazard chevrons are seen).
